revision_summary: One quote timestamp error and two schema misuses need correction before shipping. (1) In script_coverage's 'roof' section, the customer_quote 'I was looking at we have a a detached garage...' is timestamped 00:58 but actually occurs at 01:17-01:24 (at 00:58 the rep is saying 'Okay' while pulling up the home record) -- fix the ts field. (2) In cherry_pick_moments, the 02:53 'enthusiasm_signal' moment cites schema_reference 'cross_sell_signals.roof_replacement_planned' -- this is a misapplied reference (that section is about roof-replacement-triggered roofing cross-sell, unrelated to the customer proposing an alternate solar site); remove or replace with a more accurate reference (e.g., coaching_philosophy.multi_angle_resilience) or note this as an uncovered schema gap. (3) The 01:11/01:42 cherry_pick_moments cite 'verify.roof_type_age' for what is actually a shade/tree-coverage DQ, not a roof age/type issue -- retag to dq_rules or explicitly flag as a schema gap (no shade-DQ criterion exists in dq_rules today). Also reconcile the state_changes[0] label ('engaged -> deflated') with its own reasoning, which describes the customer as actively problem-solving rather than deflated -- pick a delta label consistent with the evidence. These are targeted fixes; the overall trajectory read (premature DQ from unverified satellite imagery, customer showing more resilience than the rep, no bill/interest capture) is well-grounded and should be preserved on rerun."
